q: O you who have Imaan! Never proceed (rush) ahead of Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ.
(Never do anything or comment on anything until Allaah and Rasulullaah ﷺ have issued directives concerning the matter).
Fear Allaah, for verily Allaah is All Hearing, All Knowing.
v.s: O you who have believed, do not put [yourselves] before God and His Messenger but fear God. Indeed, God is Hearing and Knowing.
v.c: O believers! Do not proceed ˹in any matter˺ before ˹a decree from˺ Allah and His Messenger. And fear Allah. Surely Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
v.h: Manners with the Prophet 1) Respect Authority

q: O you who have Imaan! Never raise your voices above the voice of the Rasool ﷺ
and do not speak to him loudly as you speak loudly with each other, lest your deeds be laid to waste without your realising it.
v.s: O you who have believed, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet or be loud to him in speech like the loudness of some of you to others, lest your deeds become worthless while you perceive not.
v.c: O believers! Do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet, nor speak loudly to him as you do to one another, or your deeds will become void while you are unaware.
v.h: Manners with the Prophet 2) Watch Your Tongue

q: Verily those who lower their voices with Rasulullaah ﷺ are the ones whose hearts Allaah has
They shall have forgiveness and a tremendous reward
(of sincerity and also implies revering the Quraan, the Rasul ﷺ, Salaat, Kaabah).
v.s: Indeed, those who lower their voices before the Messenger of God - they are the ones whose hearts God has tested for righteousness. For them is forgiveness and great reward.
v.c: Indeed, those who lower their voices in the presence of Allah’s Messenger are the ones whose hearts Allah has refined for righteousness. They will have forgiveness and a great reward.

q: (Referring to some people who shouted for Rasulullaah ﷺ from outside his quarters, Allaah says,)
Indeed most of those who call for you
(of etiquette, because of which they did not respect your privacy).
v.s: Indeed, those who call you, [O Muhammad], from behind the chambers - most of them do not use reason.
v.c: Indeed, most of those who call out to you ˹O Prophet˺ from outside ˹your˺ private quarters have no understanding ˹of manners˺.
v.h: Manners with the Prophet 3) Respect Privacy

q: they had exercised patience until you came out to
them, it would have been best for them
(because they would then not have been guilty of invading the privacy of Allaah's Rasool). (However,)
Allaah is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful
(and will forgive them if they sincerely repent).
v.s: And if they had been patient until you [could] come out to them, it would have been better for them. But God is Forgiving and Merciful.
v.c: Had they been patient until you could come out to them, it would have certainly been better for them. And Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

q: O you who have Imaan! If any sinner
brings you any news, then verify
it, lest you should harm any nation unknowingly
(In this manner, false news will be nipped in the bud.)
v.s: O you who have believed, if there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful.
v.c: O believers, if an evildoer brings you any news, verify ˹it˺ so you do not harm people unknowingly, becoming regretful for what you have done.

m: surely you would be in difficulty
q: Know well that the Rasool of Allaah is in your midst
(referring to the time when he lived with them).
There are many matters which you would place you in difficulty if he
(for the Rasool ﷺ acts on the orders of Allaah).
However, Allaah has made Imaan beloved to you, has made it beautiful within your hearts and has made kufr, sin and disobedience abhorrent
v.s: And know that among you is the Messenger of God. If he were to obey you in much of the matter, you would be in difficulty, but God has endeared to you the faith and has made it pleasing in your hearts and has made hateful to you disbelief, defiance and disobedience. Those are the [rightly] guided.
v.c: And keep in mind that Allah’s Messenger is ˹still˺ in your midst. If he were to yield to you in many matters, you would surely suffer ˹the consequences˺. But Allah has endeared faith to you, making it appealing in your hearts. And He has made disbelief, rebelliousness, and disobedience detestable to you. Those are the ones rightly guided.

q: The grace and bounty from Allaah. Allaah is All Knowing, the Wise
v.s: [It is] as bounty from God and favor. And God is Knowing and Wise.
v.c: ˹This is˺ a bounty and a blessing from Allah. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

q: If the one group transgresses against
(to live in peace and harmony with other Muslims).
(to the reconciliation process and stop quarrelling/fighting),
between them with justice. Be just, for Allaah loves those who exercise justice.
v.s: And if two factions among the believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of God. And if it returns, then make settlement between them in justice and act justly. Indeed, God loves those who act justly.
v.c: And if two groups of believers fight each other, then make peace between them. But if one of them transgresses against the other, then fight against the transgressing group until they ˹are willing to˺ submit to the rule of Allah. If they do so, then make peace between both ˹groups˺ in all fairness and act justly. Surely Allah loves those who uphold justice.

q: (because they all belong to the same Deen),
Fear Allaah so that mercy may be shown to you.
v.s: The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear God that you may receive mercy.
v.c: The believers are but one brotherhood, so make peace between your brothers. And be mindful of Allah so you may be shown mercy.

q: O you who have Imaan! Men should not mock
Neither should any women mock other women, perchance they
Never find with fault nor defame each other
and do not call each other
Imaan is indeed evil. Those who do not repent are indeed oppressors
(of their own selves because they will be subjecting themselves to punishment).
v.s: O you who have believed, let not a people ridicule [another] people; perhaps they may be better than them; nor let women ridicule [other] women; perhaps they may be better than them. And do not insult one another and do not call each other by [offensive] nicknames. Wretched is the name [i.e., mention] of disobedience after [one's] faith. And whoever does not repent - then it is those who are the wrongdoers.
v.c: O believers! Do not let some ˹men˺ ridicule others, they may be better than them, nor let ˹some˺ women ridicule other women, they may be better than them. Do not defame one another, nor call each other by offensive nicknames. How evil it is to act rebelliously after having faith! And whoever does not repent, it is they who are the ˹true˺ wrongdoers.

q: O you who have Imaan! Refrain
(suspicion and assuming evil things about people without verification).
Verily, some assumptions are a sin.
(Good assumptions about people are however encouraged.)
and never backbite each other. Does any of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother, which you so detest?
(Backbiting equals the sin of eating the dead flesh of one's brother.)
(If you repent for these sins, then remember that)
Allaah is Most Pardoning, Most Merciful.
v.s: O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? You would detest it. And fear God; indeed, God is Accepting of Repentance and Merciful.
v.c: O believers! Avoid many suspicions, ˹for˺ indeed, some suspicions are sinful. And do not spy, nor backbite one another. Would any of you like to eat the flesh of their dead brother? You would despise that! And fear Allah. Surely Allah is ˹the˺ Accepter of Repentance, Most Merciful.

m: that you may know one another
q: O people! We have certainly created you from a single male
and made you into various families
and tribes so that you may recognise each other
(so that each person may know where he belongs and who the others are). (Your differences in lineage and race do not make any of you superior to others because)
Verily, the most honoured of you in Allaah's sight is the one with the most Taqwa.
Allaah is certainly All Knowing, Informed
(Only He knows whose Taqwa is best.)
v.s: O mankind, indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another. Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of God is the most righteous of you. Indeed, God is Knowing and Acquainted.
v.c: O humanity! Indeed, We created you from a male and a female, and made you into peoples and tribes so that you may ˹get to˺ know one another. Surely the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous among you. Allah is truly All-Knowing, All-Aware.

q: The villagers say, “We have Imaan.” Say, “You do not have Imaan but rather say, 'We have accepted Islaam' because
Imaan has not yet entered your hearts.”
If you obey Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ, Allaah will not reduce
your actions in the least. Verily Allaah is Most Forgiving
v.s: The bedouins say, "We have believed." Say, "You have not [yet] believed; but say [instead], 'We have submitted,' for faith has not yet entered your hearts. And if you obey God and His Messenger, He will not deprive you from your deeds of anything. Indeed, God is Forgiving and Merciful."
v.c: ˹Some of˺ the nomadic Arabs say, “We believe.” Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “You have not believed. But say, ‘We have submitted,’ for faith has not yet entered your hearts. But if you obey Allah and His Messenger ˹wholeheartedly˺, He will not discount anything from ˹the reward of˺ your deeds. Allah is truly All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.”

q: Mu'mineen are those who believe in only Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ and then have no doubts
(about anything that comes from Allaah and Rasulullaah ﷺ);
and they Strive with their wealth and lives in Allaah's way
These are the ones who are true
(in their claim of being obedient to Allaah and Rasulullaah ﷺ).
v.s: The believers are only the ones who have believed in God and His Messenger and then doubt not but strive with their properties and their lives in the cause of God. It is those who are the truthful.
v.c: The ˹true˺ believers are only those who believe in Allah and His Messenger—never doubting— and strive with their wealth and their lives in the cause of Allah. They are the ones true in faith.

q: (to those boasting about their acceptance of Islaam),
Deen when Allaah has knowledge of whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth? Allaah has knowledge of everything.”
(There is therefore no need to inform everyone about your coming into Islaam)
v.s: Say, "Would you acquaint God with your religion while God knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and God is Knowing of all things?"
v.c: Say, “Do you inform Allah of your faith, when Allah ˹already˺ knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth? And Allah has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of all things.”

q: They boast about their favour to you that they have accepted Islaam. Say, “Do not boast to me about your acceptance of Islaam. Rather
it was Allaah Who favoured you by guiding you to Imaan,
v.s: They consider it a favor to you that they have accepted Islām. Say, "Do not consider your Islām a favor to me. Rather, God has conferred favor upon you that He has guided you to the faith, if you should be truthful."
v.c: They regard their acceptance of Islam as a favour to you. Tell ˹them, O Prophet˺, “Do not regard your Islam as a favour to me. Rather, it is Allah Who has done you a favour by guiding you to the faith, if ˹indeed˺ you are faithful.

q: Verily Allaah has knowledge of the unseen
things in the heavens and the earth and Allaah Sees what you do.
(He knows the inner condition of every person's heart and will call them to account for everything regardless of what they tell people.)
v.s: Indeed, God knows the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And God is Seeing of what you do.
v.c: Surely Allah knows the unseen of the heavens and earth. And Allah is All-Seeing of what you do.”
